concept: ActionSheet is a short lid of actions for one object that rises from the bottom of a phone, the rows printed like Menu's and Cancel a separate plastic key, and on a wide screen it opens as a panel by its key.
difference_from_sheet: Derived in its own round because Sheet is itself a member of Dialog's family. Sheet holds a device's controls that act at once and closes from a header key; ActionSheet holds three to six one-shot actions for one object, closes the moment one runs, ends with a full-width Cancel key instead of a close key, has no drag bar, and on a wide screen stands by its trigger like Menu instead of at the lower end.

default_to_avoid.pattern: iOS action sheet with a blue Cancel button and red Delete text on two frosted bodies
default_to_avoid.why_not: Blue and red text is colour alone telling which action is which, and frosted glass is a second material; P1 and FORM's display rule ask for glyph plus word on one plastic body.

default_to_avoid.pattern: Material modal bottom sheet list with a grey pill handle
default_to_avoid.why_not: A pill handle invites a drag the sheet does not need, and a full list with no Cancel leaves the scrim as the only visible way out.

references.source: Braun T 1000 world receiver (Dieter Rams, 1963): a lid that opens to show what the device can do, then closes over it
Braun ET 66 calculator (Dietrich Lubs, 1987): the one key that differs is told by shape and position, the rest are equal
WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices, Dialog (Modal) pattern: focus moves in, Escape closes, focus returns to the opener

derivation.consequence: sits where the hand expects it (lower or right of the display)
derivation.form: On a phone the lid docks to the bottom edge under the thumb, with Cancel last where the thumb rests.

derivation.consequence: links, borders, icons, selections and charts never use it
derivation.form: No row and no key is orange; Remove carries the critical square lamp beside its word, so the warning is shape and word.

derivation.consequence: every part keeps ≥44px hit area even when it draws smaller
derivation.form: Each row is at least control.md tall across the full width, and Cancel is a control.lg capsule key.

derivation.consequence: labels sit on the body's inset line, never floating mid-surface
derivation.form: The object's name and its lowercase detail sit on the top inset line, the rows printed on the same line below them.

derivation.consequence: no entry choreography, no idle animation; transitions only on state
derivation.form: The lid slides up as one piece on the enter easing and leaves faster; the rows never stagger in.

options.name: lid with a key, one docked body with Menu's printed rows and a full-width plastic Cancel key; a panel by the trigger on wide screens
two bodies, the actions on one floating body and Cancel on a second body under it
key bank, every action a raised capsule key stacked in the lid

variants.reason: A keeps one body per decision and reuses Menu's printed rows, so Remove is told by its lamp and place while Cancel is the only raised key (P1, P3); B spends two bodies on one choice and wastes phone width, and C gives Remove the same weight and reach as Rename.

root.why: The lid is a body of matte plastic with the capped panel radius and one light from the top left.

bottom.why: Docked to the bottom edge across the full width, the rows and Cancel sit under the thumb.

anchored.why: On a wide screen the panel stands by the key that opened it, where the pointer already is.

inline.why: A preview lid sits in the flow of the page at a fixed place and covers nothing.

head.why: The object's name and its detail sit together on the top inset line, printed on the case.

title.why: The object's name is printed at the emphasis size in medium weight, so it is read first.

detail.why: The detail is printed at caption size in the secondary ink, a quiet line under the name.

rows.why: The actions are printed one under another on the same inset line as the name.

item.why: Each action row is at least control.md tall across the full width of the lid.

icon.why: The row glyph is printed flat in the secondary ink, never filled and never embossed.

lamp.why: The destructive row carries the critical square lamp beside its word, so the warning is shape and word, never orange.

text.why: The action word is printed at body size in the primary ink, a verb first.

destructive.why: A destructive action is printed last after a small gap, in a fixed place away from the thumb's first reach.

cancel.why: Cancel stands apart under a gap as the one raised capsule key, as wide as the lid.

focus.why: The focused row is pressed into the body as a nested recess, the same as a Menu row.

focus-visible.why: Keyboard focus also draws the shared focus ring on the row so the target is plain.

aria-disabled=true.why: An action that cannot run keeps its place and fades to half, so the rows never move.

data-state=open.why: The open lid slides up from its edge on the enter easing as one body with all its rows.

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: Under reduced motion the lid appears and leaves at once, with no slide and no fade.

@media forced-colors: active.why: In forced colours the lid keeps a real border and the focused row a highlight edge so both survive.

opacity.why: The body fades with its slide so the scrim and the lid arrive and leave as one change of state.

transform.why: The only travel is the slide from the bottom edge over motion.release in and the shorter motion.exit out.
